title: Wikipedia — Rebecca (Cyberpunk: Edgerunners)
summary: The checked secondary account describes an augmented woman, Pilar's sister, and a mercenary crewmate; she has unreturned feelings for David, helps rescue Lucy, and is killed by Adam Smasher. Tomoyo Kurosawa is credited for Japanese. These details are attributed, not a new viewing. Crossovers and speculative Mox affiliation are excluded.

demographics.canonical_death_mechanism: Killed by Adam Smasher in the original anime finale
